authority.rule: Funding and salary are first-class route variables. Do not rank a PhD or job on institutional/career value while leaving current cash economics implicit.

decision_model.phd_value_expression: admission_probability × funding_certainty × current_cash × research_value × credential_conversion_value × post_phd_option_value
decision_model.job_value_expression: offer_probability × compensation_certainty × current_cash × skill_growth × brand/network_value × long_run_income_ceiling
anti_error_rules: Do not treat 'up to' scholarship amounts as guaranteed cash.
Do not compare a hypothetical elite-job salary with a funded PhD as if both outcomes were certain.
Do not treat admission without funding as equivalent to funded admission.
Do not let prestige override a verified large compensation or funding difference without an explicit strategic reason.
Reverify volatile job compensation and scholarship rules before a final accept/reject decision.

phd_monthly_funding_ntd.guidance: Serious competitor to ordinary Taiwan full-time work when research/career value is high.
Acceptable for a high-value program such as IAIS if research and credential upside are strong.
Needs unusually strong supervisor, network, publication or credential value to beat full-time work.
Normally dominated by viable full-time employment unless the route is strategically exceptional.

full_time_monthly_cash_ntd.guidance: A real economic alternative to a funded PhD; compare research freedom and credential conversion directly.
PhD requires a stronger non-cash strategic case.
Compensation is large enough that the PhD decision must be reopened even for excellent funded programs.

decision_bands.note: These are Gauntlet decision heuristics, not market facts or automatic acceptance rules.

verified_cash_anchors.first_24_months: Up to NT$30,000/month fully funded by IAIS.
verified_cash_anchors.months_25_48: Up to NT$10,000/month from IAIS plus advisor contribution of at least NT$20,000/month.
verified_cash_anchors.employment_constraint: Full-time remunerated employment or in-service student status is ineligible under the IAIS scholarship rules.
verified_cash_anchors.stacking_constraint: Recipients who also receive the specified NSTC/MOE PhD scholarship must choose one rather than stack both.
verified_cash_anchors.budget_risk: Recipient count and subsidy amount may be adjusted if IAIS funding is reduced.

verified_cash_anchors.first_24_months: Up to NT$40,000/month fully funded by IAIS.
verified_cash_anchors.months_25_48: Up to NT$30,000/month from IAIS plus advisor matching of at least NT$20,000/month.
verified_cash_anchors.later_stage_note: NT$50,000/month is a nominal combination of the stated up-to IAIS amount plus minimum advisor match; it is not guaranteed because the IAIS component is explicitly 'up to'.
verified_cash_anchors.employment_constraint: Full-time remunerated employment or in-service student status is ineligible under the IAIS scholarship rules.
verified_cash_anchors.stacking_constraint: Recipients who also receive the specified NSTC/MOE PhD scholarship must choose one rather than stack both.
verified_cash_anchors.budget_risk: Recipient count and subsidy amount may be adjusted if IAIS funding is reduced.

verified_cash_anchors.second_year: May be extended for one more year for students who perform well.
verified_cash_anchors.later_years: Further support depends on the individual thesis advisor after the stipend period.

verified_cash_anchors.formal_gate: Master's required; listed majors are Information Management, EE, Electronics and CS.

verified_cash_anchors.experience_requirement: No prior work experience required in the captured posting.

iais_elite_vs_itri_first_two_years.interpretation: The verified ITRI floor exceeds the IAIS elite headline by NT$15,000/month. That is meaningful but much smaller than the usual funded-PhD-versus-industry caricature, so research/credential value can plausibly offset the cash gap.

iais_elite_vs_point72.interpretation: A real Point72 offer would materially reopen the decision; do not compare this hypothetical outcome to IAIS as if the offer were certain.

nycu_iais.reason: Unusually strong conjunction of admission fit, AI research identity, NYCU network, credential conversion, and viable current cash flow.
nycu_iais.hard_condition: Funding must be explicitly awarded; admission alone does not inherit the 30k/40k amount.

tigp.reason: NT$40,000 first-year tax-free stipend plus strong research environment; later-year funding continuity requires explicit advisor assessment.

itri.reason: Verified NT$55,000+ monthly floor and unusually direct agent/harness/LLM skill fit, offset by a real formal degree-field gate.

point72.reason: NT$2.2m+ posted annual floor is economically transformative, but conversion probability is much lower than funded-PhD probability and must remain separate from headline salary.

unknown_salary_or_funding_routes.rule: Do not assign a money-weighted priority until salary, stipend, tuition burden and funding certainty are verified or an actual offer is received.
